ext.description: Save, monitor quota, and switch between multiple Kiro accounts with one click.
viewContainer.title: Kiro Accounts
cfg.title: Kiro Account Switcher
cfg.syncBoth: Synchronize **both** `kiro-auth-token-code.json` (VS Code) and `kiro-auth-token.json` (Kiro IDE / global) when switching or signing out.
cfg.fetchEmail: Automatically query the Kiro **Get-Usage-Limits** API to fetch the account email, user ID, subscription plan, and remaining usage quota.
cfg.autoReload: Automatically reload the VS Code window after switching accounts. By default Kiro detects token file changes within ~5 seconds.
cfg.progressBar: Show a text-based progress bar `[████░░]` in the status bar tooltip for quota usage.
